who: Alexandru Nazare, a Romanian official announcing the government’s 'Diaspora Investește Acasă' program that allocates €100 million to encourage diaspora investment in Romania.
fit_reason: The source is a news article about a broad investment initiative, not an individual diaspora member actively building, renovating, or planning a house. It lacks concrete signals of personal house construction or monitoring needs.
hooks: Mention of the Diaspora Investește Acasă program and its €100 million fund, which may motivate diaspora to invest in Romanian property.
Opportunity to position Ochi pe Șantier as a monitoring solution for diaspora investors who want verified progress reports on homes they fund.
